project_type: noFriction — Tauri 2 desktop app (Rust backend + React/TypeScript frontend) for Mac, with an iOS (SwiftUI) parity layer under ios/. Local-first, no servers.
build_system: Vite + tsc for the frontend; Cargo for the Rust/Tauri backend. QUIRK: never run `npm run build` — it bumps the build number (COORDINATION.md §2); use `npx tsc --noEmit` for the frontend type gate. The app ships in two Mac flavors: default (Developer ID DMG) and `--features mas` (sandboxed Mac App Store) — BOTH must build and test.
test_framework: Rust: built-in `cargo test --lib` (study/tests.rs is the pattern; use a mock completer, never hit an endpoint). TypeScript: `node --test` (NOT vitest) — `package.json` test script is `TZ=UTC node --test src/lib/*.test.ts`; write tests in the node:test + node:assert style of src/lib/studyLogic.test.ts, importing `.ts` with explicit extensions.
build_command: cd src-tauri && cargo build   (and cargo build --features mas)
test_command: cd src-tauri && cargo test --lib   AND   cargo test --lib --features mas   ;   npx tsc --noEmit   ;   npm test   ;   python3 scripts/check-ai-provider-policy.py
verification_instructions: After each feature: (1) `cd src-tauri && cargo test --lib` and `cargo test --lib --features mas` both green; (2) `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; (3) `npm test` green; (4) `python3 scripts/check-ai-provider-policy.py` passes; (5) for the frontend, `scripts/check-lessons-offline.*` finds no remote reference in the compiled Lessons bundle/CSS; (6) grep confirms no dangerouslySetInnerHTML under src/components/lessons/ or src/lib/lessonLogic*. Do NOT run `npm run build`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The shipped seed bundle src-tauri/resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson is produced by the authoring script scripts/author-seed-lessons.* from scripts/seed/*.json + the genmedia-authored figure PNGs (manifest scripts/seed/figures.manifest.json). Re-run the authoring script to regenerate it. The resources/seed/ dir does not exist yet — create it.
environment_constraints: Zip crate must be added (zip = "=2.2.0", pure-Rust, deflate/stored only) — image = 0.25, sha2, serde_json, uuid, sqlx 0.7, chrono, rand 0.9, async-trait are already in src-tauri/Cargo.toml. HARD INVARIANTS (violation = build fails): no noFriction server/relay/iCloud/Supabase/Pinecone; no runtime AI/image network call for a present lesson (taking a lesson is 100% offline + free); never hardcode/bundle an API key or default remote URL; never render model/bundle output as HTML; all AI calls go through ai::client::complete with Pro/consent/endpoint gating (only the DEFERRED generation path, not built now); generated-provenance lessons join Delete/Strike purge, seed/imported exempt; `python3 scripts/check-ai-provider-policy.py` must pass. Another agent works branch fix/mac-post-launch in a separate locked worktree — edit shared files APPEND-style (add at end of arrays/enums/icon sets, never reorder) and expect a Cargo.lock conflict resolved on the pre-PR rebase onto origin/main.
contribution_requirements: Follow DESIGN.md exactly: hazard-yellow #facc15 tokens on matte black, Inter font (bundled, never a CDN), sentence case everywhere, SVG icons from src/components/icons.tsx (append-only, 24x24 viewBox currentColor round caps strokeWidth 1.5), no emoji as icons, semantic tokens only (never raw hex). WCAG: keyboard operable, visible 2px focus ring, 4.5:1 body contrast, 44px targets, ARIA landmarks, prefers-reduced-motion honored, a screen-reader text-equivalent for every interactive explainer. Vocabulary (DESIGN.md): noun 'lesson' / 'lesson set', verb 'Make lesson', button 'Generate', 'Import a lesson…'. Lessons is a first-class FOURTH top-bar view (D1): Record ⌘1 · Recordings ⌘2 · Lessons ⌘3 · Chat ⌘4.
key_patterns: Mirror the study subsystem (src-tauri/src/study.rs + study/parse.rs + study/tests.rs): tolerant parse (serde_json + trailing-comma fallback, unknown fields ignored) then strict validate + clean_text, store only cleaned structured data, render as plain text / typed React components (never HTML). ensure_schema uses crate::database::ensure_columns / CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and is registered in database.rs::run_migrations next to crate::study::ensure_schema (~line 1079). Commands register in lib.rs invoke_handler next to the study::commands::* block (~line 886-890). Purge hooks: redaction.rs::redact_ai_outputs calls study::purge_for_meeting (~line 668) — add lessons beside it; backup purge needs a job-kind-independent call inside redaction.rs::purge_one_backup after the `for job in jobs` match and before tx.commit(); recording-delete cascade slots beside topics/chat purge in database.rs::delete_meeting (~line 1350). View switching is menu-driven: menu_builder.rs defines VIEW_* ids with CmdOrCtrl+N accelerators and emits menu:view_* which App.tsx listens for (no JS keydown for views). The certificate/export reuses the files.user-selected.read-write sandbox grant. Correctness/grading is authoritative in Rust; the TS mirror (src/lib/lessonLogic.ts) is preview-only, never decides pass/fail.

directory_structure: src-tauri/src/ holds the Rust backend (study.rs + study/ is the sibling pattern; create lessons.rs + lessons/). src-tauri/resources/ does not exist yet — create resources/seed/ for the shipped bundle. src/components/ holds React components (views/ for top-level views, study/ for the study UI, lessons/ is net-new); src/lib/ holds pure TS logic + node:test tests. scripts/ holds Python policy guards + release scripts; add the authoring script + the frontend offline guard here. docs/ holds the design/architecture/redaction docs to update. ios/ holds the SwiftUI parity layer (ProFeature.swift key must match pro.ts).
